verdict.headline: One B trade: USD/CAD long
verdict.reason: USD/CAD broke 1.4028 and retested it with rejection wicks. With your new 1.4053 resistance as the target it clears 1:2 (about 1:2.3). Everything else is still on the watchlist with no setup.

trigger.note: Two small candles at the retest wicked about 2-4 pips below 1.4028 and closed back above it.

news.note: The 5:30am PT US data is out. No red-folder time was confirmed for today. BoC and the Fed decide tomorrow, so expect cautious trade.

setups.notes: Grade B: follow-through is false because one full red candle gave back the whole spike to the level before price recovered. Entry about 1.4032, SL 2 pips under the retest low near 1.4025, TP at your marked 1.4053. Risk about 9 pips, reward about 21, so about 1:2.3. Filling at the ask (about 1.4032-1.4033) trims that to about 1:2.2 or 1:2.1. Expires 2:00pm PT. The latest chart's candles lag the live quote, so this uses the 7:26am chart and the quote. A close back below 1.4028 downgrades it to C.

watchlist.missing: Price fell about 90 pips to the marked support and bounced from a low of about 1.1134 without closing below it. No break, so no setup. A candle body closing below 1.1135 with displacement would start a short break-and-retest; the next marked level below does not exist yet.

Level broke with displacement and follow-through (to about 157.91), and price is retesting it now. Lows near 157.58 poked under the line and closed back above, but there is no clean engulfing or pin bar yet, and the M5 structure break can't be confirmed from the M15 chart (marked false). Targeting the 157.91 swing high with SL at 157.55 only gives 1:2 if entry is at or below about 157.67. No marked resistance above price to use as TP.

C. The first break of 0.7034 failed: price closed back below it (down to about 0.7029) before 2:00pm PT. It then pushed back above and spiked to about 0.7040, and is now at 0.7035 testing the level again, but a failed break stays C. The candles at the level are small with no clear engulfing or pin bar, and there is no marked resistance above price to check 1:2 (the 0.7040 high is only about 5 pips). A clean new setup needs a full-bodied close above with follow-through, a retest that holds with a trigger candle, and a marked target.

No S/R was marked, so nothing can be graded. Price is in an uptrend and sits near 0.8284 under a swing high of about 0.8290-0.8292 that has been tested twice (possible double top, not confirmed). Mark the levels you want graded; a close below the recent low near 0.8280 would need a trigger and a marked target to check 1:2.

Price is at 0.5702, just under marked resistance at 0.5707, which has been tested four times with wicks and no candle body closing above it. No break, so no setup. A full-bodied close above 0.5707 with follow-through, then a retest that holds with an engulfing or pin bar, would start a long; mark the next resistance above to check 1:2. Marked support is at 0.5677, about 30 pips below.

Missed, not a trade now. Price closed below 1.3345 with displacement and follow-through (about 40 pips), came back to retest it from below and was rejected, then fell to the marked support at 1.3313 (wick to about 1.3303) and bounced to 1.3328. On paper a short from about 1.3340 with SL about 1.3350 and TP 1.3313 was over 1:2, but it formed before the 6:00am PT window and has already reached its target. The M5 structure break can't be confirmed from the M15 chart (marked false) and the retest candle is not a clean trigger. From 1.3328 there is only about 15 pips to 1.3313 and about 17 pips to 1.3345, so neither side gives 1:2.

newsBlocks: The calendar couldn't be confirmed. No red-folder times for today were found. US data usually lands at 5:30am PT; check it before entering anything on USD pairs.
Fed meeting starts today with the decision tomorrow (Oct 28, 11:00am PT); BoC and RBNZ also decide tomorrow. Expect thin, cautious trade.
watchFor: USD/CAD long: a close back below 1.4028 before 2:00pm PT downgrades it to C. Set and forget otherwise: no moving the SL, no partials.

AUD/USD: the first break failed (C). It would need a fresh full-bodied close above 0.7034 with follow-through, a retest that holds with an engulfing or pin bar, and a marked resistance above price to check 1:2.

USD/JPY: after 6:00am PT, a clear engulfing or pin bar at the 157.65 retest that holds, with entry at or below about 157.67, SL about 157.55 and TP at 157.91 or a newly marked resistance. Mark the next resistance above price to confirm 1:2.
USD/JPY: a close back below 157.65 before 2:00pm PT makes the break fail (C).

GBP/USD: a new retest of 1.3345 from below after 6:00am PT with an engulfing or pin bar (TP at 1.3313 only gives 1:2 from about 1.3340 with a 2-3 pip stop beyond the swing), or a full-bodied close below 1.3313 then a retest that holds from below with a trigger candle. Mark the next support below price to check R:R.
NZD/USD: a full-bodied close above 0.5707 (or below 0.5677), then a retest that holds with a trigger candle. Mark the next level beyond to check 1:2. A fourth rejection at 0.5707 is not a trade.
EUR/USD: a full-bodied close below 1.1135, then a retest that holds from below with a trigger candle. Mark support below price first to check R:R.
All 7 majors were sent. EUR/USD, USD/JPY, USD/CHF, NZD/USD and GBP/USD were sent on M15; USD/CAD and AUD/USD on M5. Setups expire 2:00pm PT.
